applicability: Marketplace Portal service. Policy edition 2026-09-01. Collection Profile and CORE terms are separate.
content:
Identify the transaction, receiving currency, submission date and recorded payment status. Foreign-currency payments normally take one to five business days; holidays can extend the period. CNY payments are normally received the same day, with some completing in about a minute. These are typical times, not guarantees for a payment under investigation.

If a trace is needed, submit the transaction ID and relevant details to support. An MT103 or GPI tracking request concerns the actual payment's progress. A request for the sending bank's account details is a different request and needs its business purpose identified.

Once a Portal transfer is submitted, it cannot normally be cancelled. If a VAT reference, recipient account, name or address was wrong, support can attempt a bank-message amendment using the corrected details. Whether the bank can accept an amendment depends on its processing state and rules.

The recipient should not send a fresh payment to the sending account to return the funds. Ask the recipient bank to return the original transfer through its return process. The sending account is not provided as a general receiving destination.

The Portal selects the outgoing payment route based on the recipient's country, currency and bank; support cannot promise a customer-selected route.
